name: Karkas
tagline: Canopies, hangars and frames — engineered, not eyeballed
niche: Turnkey steel structures: canopies, hangars, warehouses and building frames

listing.description: A website for a steel-structure, canopy or hangar builder. The truss on the first screen draws itself bar by bar with dimensions, a canopy calculator prices by area, stages appear as a Gantt chart and projects as drawing sheets.

seo.title: Karkas — canopies and steel structures in Tashkent
seo.description: Turnkey car and terrace canopies, hangars, warehouses and building frames: load calculations, KM drawings, fabrication and erection. Online cost calculator.
seo.answer: Karkas is an engineering company at 31 Fargona Yuli Street, Tashkent, that designs, fabricates and erects canopies, hangars and building frames. A tube canopy with polycarbonate starts at 450,000 sum per m², with metal sheeting at 520,000 sum and a hangar at 900,000 sum per m². The site visit and calculation are free and structures carry a 10-year guarantee.

business.areaServed: Tashkent and the regions of Uzbekistan

sections.title: Canopies and frames, engineered
sections.subtitle: We account for snow, wind and soil before cutting any steel. Our own 1,200 m² shop, erection crews and a 10-year structural guarantee.

items.quote: The engineer told us right away that our sketch would not carry the snow and recalculated the truss. The price went up 8%, but we sleep easy.
items.author: Rustam

items.quote: A six-car canopy went up in a week with no dust in the yard; everything was welded in the shop.
items.author: Gulnora

items.quote: They built the hangar to drawings that later passed the state review without comments.
items.author: Farrukh

items.a: A tube canopy with polycarbonate starts at 450,000 sum per m² turnkey; one car needs about 18 m², so from 8,100,000 sum. The engineer gives the exact price after a visit.
Snow and wind loads in Tashkent can be higher than they look: without a calculation a truss is either overbuilt or it sags. We do the calculation for free.

items.q: Do I need a building permit?
items.a: Usually not for a canopy in a private yard. For hangars and warehouses we prepare KM drawings and help with the approval paperwork.
Yes, across Uzbekistan. Structures ship from the plant and crews work on rotation; an engineer’s regional visit is 300,000 sum, deducted from the contract.
Ten years on load-bearing structures and three years on paint and roofing, written into the contract.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Free engineer visit
sections.text: Leave a request and an engineer will call, clarify the brief and visit the site on a day that suits you.
